description: Evaluation questions for Customer Care: Product Warranty & Claims

eval_cases.input: What is our total vendor warranty recovery realization percentage across all suppliers this quarter?
Which product categories account for the highest warranty repair and replacement costs YTD?
What is the average repair turnaround time (in days) across all certified repair centers?
List the top registered products by active warranty volume and their claim frequency rate.
What are the standard industry warranty recovery rates and Right to Repair trends in consumer electronics retail?
